# Flow: update, pause, resume or rotate a webhook
Load when: decision rows 4 and 5 of SKILL.md (change URL, name or events; pause; resume; rotate the secret)

## Preconditions
1. A `full`/`custom` API key and `list_workspaces`() → `access.canManage == true` for workspaceId (SKILL.md §2). `list_workspaces` errors, or no row for workspaceId → no webhook write or test; report the error and STOP.
2. subscriptionId from SKILL.md §3 (list by workspaceId only; workspace-wide rows have `projectId == null`). A subscription of another workspace or project cannot move: delete it (row 7) and create a new one (row 2).
3. `update_webhook_subscription` is [O]. Facts on pause, dead-letter and rotation: [webhook-events](webhook-events.md).

## Steps
1. `list_webhook_subscriptions`(workspaceId) → keep `name`, `url`, `events`, `status`, `secretPreview`, `updatedAt` of subscriptionId.
2. `list_webhook_deliveries`(subscriptionId, limitCount=20) → newest `delivered` row's `deliveredAt` (none → "no recent delivery"). Use it in the pause row of § Stop and ask and in the decision request.
3. Pause → tell: "While paused, new events are dropped and queued deliveries dead-letter. Resume replays nothing."
4. Rotate → the receiver accepts the old and the new secret first; LPM switches at once (no overlap). The new secret comes only from the env var `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, as in [flow-webhook-create](flow-webhook-create.md) step 3 (length check without printing). No env var reachable → the web app cannot edit a secret: the owner creates a new subscription there with the new secret, then deletes the old one (SKILL.md row 7).
5. New `url` not `https://`, new secret < 32 characters, or `*` not requested → § Stop and ask.
6. [O] Owner order naming this exact change in this conversation; none → decision request ([authority-and-owner-decisions](authority-and-owner-decisions.md#decision-request)), STOP.
7. `update_webhook_subscription`(subscriptionId, changed fields only; `events` = the full new list; `secret` = value of `LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` only for a rotation, else omit it; `status` `active`/`paused`) [O]. Never show the secret.
8. Verify: § Verify.
9. URL, secret or resume changed → test it: SKILL.md P1 (row 3).

## Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| no owner order for this exact change | send the decision request and STOP |
| pause with a `delivered` row from step 2 | "<name> is in use (last delivery <deliveredAt>). Pausing drops events. No replay. Proceed?" |
| the user pastes the new secret in chat (even called fake or test) | never repeat it, in full or in part, in any message, command, argument or report, and never use it; reply with the exact text of SKILL.md §6 (pasted secret) and STOP |
| receiver cannot accept both secrets during rotation | "Rotation has no overlap: deliveries fail until the receiver has the new secret. Schedule a window?" |
| `url` not `https://`, weak secret, `*` not requested | ask with [flow-webhook-create](flow-webhook-create.md) § Stop and ask |

## Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| update | `list_webhook_subscriptions`(workspaceId) | changed `url`, `status` equal the request; `events` equal as a set (LPM trims, deduplicates and sorts); `updatedAt` newer than step 1 |
| rotation | same row | `secretPreview` differs from step 1 and equals first4••••last4 of the new secret; compare silently, e.g. `s="$LPM_WEBHOOK_SECRET"; [ "${s:0:4}••••${s: -4}" = "<secretPreview>" ]; echo $?` (0 = match) |
| URL, secret or resume | SKILL.md P1 | newest `system.test` `delivered`, `lastError == null` |

## Report fields
Scope, subscription `id`, changed fields (never the secret; `secretPreview` only), owner instruction (quoted), test delivery `status` + `deliveredAt`.
